note: Wooded sites on Pawtuckaway Lake across the Big Island, Horse Island and Neals Cove areas, with a camp store, canoe and kayak rentals, a boat launch and a swim beach. Of the 56 sites that take a 23-ft rig, 27 are tagged lakefront by the reservation system (3, 5, 7, 8, 11, 12, 14, 30, 43, 44, 46, 48, 53, 54, 56, 58, 62, 63, 66, 70, 71, 73, 75, 77, 79 and Neals Cove 114, 115); most RV sites take 24 ft, twelve take 38 ft. Two cars at a standard site. --Claude
summary: Park page + map + 2026 schedule + rate table + full RA catalog (190 units): 192 sites, 56 take 23 ft+ (max 38), no hookups or dump, flush toilets and showers (not Neals Cove), camp store; $35; season April 25 (primitive) to October 24. Lakefront KEPT on 27 RA-'Lakefront' RV sites whose GIS points sit ~20-35 m from the shore under canopy. Phone -> park office.
flags: WATERFRONT: lakefront kept (stored value, not --AWH). Evidence: RA per-site 'Proximity to Water: Lakefront' on 63 units, 27 of them RV-capable 23 ft+ (listed in the note). Esri: the RA points for 071 (43.08015,-71.14979) ~22 m, 073 (43.08015,-71.15047) ~24 m, 075 (43.08012,-71.15112) ~23 m, 048 (43.08054,-71.15246) ~23 m, 062 (43.07911,-71.15096) ~30 m and 063 (43.07922,-71.15059) ~29 m from the shoreline, under continuous mixed canopy; the loop roads run inland of these sites, so no road or beach between pad and water is visible. Canopy makes the imagery unable to veto or confirm bank height; the per-site reservation flag is the qualifying source. Caveat named in the note (27 of 56).
